title: ΔM-Antigravity: A Numerical Model of Repulsive Force Between Nested Mass Layers
description:
A numerical model in which the force between two nested mass layers contains a repulsive term proportional to the mass difference ΔM. The model is regularized by a tanh function and yields a stable equilibrium at radius r_eq, which scales as r_eq ∝ (M/ΔM)^(1/3). Unlike the cosmological constant Λ, the effect is local and depends only on local masses.

The reference implementation is written in Python (NumPy only) and includes numerical verification of the equilibrium radius scaling. Similarities and differences with the Λ-term and Yukawa-type interactions are discussed.

Research prototype (TRL 3). Not a physical theory, not experimentally validated.
